paper_title: New solar X-ray constraints on keV Axion-Like Particles
notes: Limits on hadronic ALPs (gae=0) in (g_agamma, m) plane from combined SphinX+NuSTAR solar X-ray data, improved by ~1 order of magnitude via photon coalescence. No local DM density assumption is made (explicitly stated). Data points approximate, read from Fig. 1 (coalescence/NuSTAR curve) since no numerical table is provided; values should be treated as rough. The leading limits are quoted between 3 keV and 40 keV. Multi-coupling paper (also gae), but primary exclusion plot y-axis is g_agamma. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.55, 8))
